description.en: The IP address of the protected object.
The port of the protected object.

description.zh:
防护对象的端口范围。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The port range of the protected object.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

description.zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

- **tcp**：表示传输控制协议。
- **udp**：表示用户数据报协议。
description.en:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Transmission Control Protocol.

- **udp**: User Datagram Protocol.

description.zh:
策略类型。取值
- **default**：表示默认防护策略
- **l3**：表示IP防护策略
- **l4**：表示端口防护策略
description.en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:

- **default**: The default mitigation policy.

- **l3**: An IP address-specific mitigation policy.

- **l4**: A port-specific mitigation policy.

description.zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

- **不填**：解绑默认 surf 防护引擎策略。
- **2**：解绑新版 stream 防护引擎策略。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

- If you do not specify this parameter, the default Surf deep packet inspection (DPI) engine policy is detached.

- If you set this parameter to **2**, the new Stream DPI engine policy is detached.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

title.zh: 防护对象取消关联防护策略

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp detach-from-policy --policy-type l3 --ip-port-protocol-list PortRange=80-90 Ip=47.118.172.000 Port=80 Protocol=tcp --port-version 2 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
